criteria: A Team admin's chosen refinement states are read back from the Team's settings after the save and after a reload
A Team with at least one refinement state reports refinementConfigured true to every reader of the Team; a Team with none, or whose states were all cleared, reports false
A settings save that carries no refinement member leaves the chosen states exactly as they were; a save carrying an empty list clears them
A Team reader who is not a Team admin cannot change the refinement states (403) and the stored states are unchanged
Saving refinement states leaves every Work Item the Team holds in place (Work Item count unchanged)
The schema change is one nullable Teams.RefinementSettings column, present for SQLite and Postgres, generated by Create-Migration.ps1, and removable without data loss (expand-only)

Then the frontend: SizingLogService.castVote, the voter key on the tab read, the 'Your vote' and 'Votes' grid columns, the 'Who is voting?' dialog, the 'Votes and comments' dialog with the split and 'Voting as <name> · Change your name', and the browser half of TeamSizingVoteCast.

steps.name: A reader without sign-in casts a vote and the tab counts it as theirs
steps.description: The walking skeleton of the vote write. New append-only SizingLogEntry (all columns of the design's table, including those slices 12, 16 and 17b use later) and the migration AddSizingLogEntries; ISizingLogRepository (Append, ReadForTeam; no update or remove member); ISizingLogCommands / SizingLogCommands (vote only); VoterIdentityResolver, auth-off path (declared name + X-Lighthouse-Voter-Key, stored as 'self:' + SHA-256 of the key); RbacGuardRequirement.TeamContribute mapped to CanReadTeamAsync and treated by RbacGuardAttribute as a scoped read requirement (non-disclosing 404); RefinementVotesController with POST …/work-items/{workItemId}/votes answering the updated row. The tab read gains voterIdentity ('SelfDeclared' here) and per-row voteCount and myVote.
criteria: Without sign-in, a POST of { answer: 'Yes', channel: 'Web', voterName } with an X-Lighthouse-Voter-Key of at least 32 characters answers 200 with the row as it now stands: voteCount 1, myVote 'Yes'
The same voter's next read of the tab shows that row with voteCount 1 and myVote 'Yes'; the tab says voterIdentity 'SelfDeclared'

Every entry is appended; no code path updates or deletes a SizingLogEntries row (ArchUnitNET: ISizingLogRepository has no member starting Update, Remove or Delete, and nothing calls ExecuteUpdate*, ExecuteDelete* or Remove on SizingLogEntries)

Every controller action carrying TeamContribute lives in RefinementVotesController (allowlist test); RefinementController stays read-only and the read path reaches no repository write and no ICurrentUserProfileService

The migration exists for SQLite and Postgres, generated by Create-Migration.ps1, expand-only; the TeamId cascade and VoterProfileId SET NULL exist as database constraints on both providers (crafter-written assertion)
Each entry captures the yardstick it was cast against (days, source, probability), pinned by a SizingLogCommands unit case because no port reads it yet
dotnet build has zero warnings
steps.implementation_notes: EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: C#/.NET + NUnit (no Hypothesis); the WebApplicationFactory scenarios are single-example wiring checks over real EF. Compensate with parametrised value-in/value-out NUnit cases on VoterIdentityResolver (auth-off: name trimmed 1-100, key >= 32 chars, stored 'self:' + lower-hex SHA-256) and SizingLogCommands (exactly one row appended, carrying Channel, VoterDisplayName, RecordedAt from ILighthouseClock and the yardstick); the acceptance category is excluded from Stryker. MIGRATION: build the backend first (the migration DLLs are HintPath references), then run Lighthouse.Backend/Create-Migration.ps1 -MigrationName AddSizingLogEntries so both providers get it - never 'dotnet ef migrations add'. Expand-only (ExpandOnlyMigrationGuard): one new table SizingLogEntries with every column the design lists (Id, TeamId FK cascade, WorkItemReferenceId text - not a FK to the Work Item row, Kind, Answer?, Comment? <= 2000, VoterKey, VoterProfileId? FK SET NULL, VoterDisplayName, RecordedAt UTC, Channel, YardstickDays?, YardstickSource, YardstickProbability?) and the index (TeamId, WorkItemReferenceId, Id); later slices add no migration. Then rebuild each migrations csproj and the solution --no-incremental before verifying (PendingModelChanges trap). HistoricalSchemaPatch: not needed - this migration adds a table and touches no Deliveries (or Teams) column, and no fixture seeds it; add an entry only if a migration fixture fails naming a SizingLogEntries column. IDENTITY: VoterIdentityResolver decides auth on/off from IAuthModeResolver.Resolve().Mode, never from 'profile is null' (auth off carries the shared subject lighthouse|auth-disabled); the auth-on branch is slice 15's. On reads it derives the caller's key from the header alone, never through ICurrentUserProfileService (whose get-or-create touches a row). The key is never returned by any endpoint; rows say myVote instead. Refusals are ProblemDetails with Extensions['code'] (codes arrive in 11-03/11-04). The vote body also accepts an optional comment (<= 2000) and stores it - 11-07's no-personal-data test posts a vote with a comment; showing it is slice 12's. RBAC: append TeamContribute (append-only ordinal), map it in CanSatisfyRequirementAsync to CanReadTeamAsync (one call, no second rule), add it to RbacGuardAttribute.RequiresScope() and IsReadRequirement() so a failed check answers 404, not 403. Read/write split: RefinementController keeps the GETs, the new RefinementVotesController takes the writes (keeps both under S107). The tab read takes the X-Lighthouse-Voter-Key header so the query can mark myVote. Program.cs edit: registers the new services; in CI it forces the full live-connector Integration suite (expect that flake exposure, do not debug it as a regression). ARCHITECTURE.md already describes the sizing log and the reader-write rule: re-read those sections and the ADR 214-218 row and, in this same commit, drop anything the maintainer's 2026-10-04 decision changed (no hidden split; every reader sees the split and the comments). Un-skip one scenario at a time; each must fail for MISSING_FUNCTIONALITY first (distill/red-classification.md). No code comment may cite an internal id (DSN-, DST-, DVO-, AC-, ADR-, DD-, US-): write the reason in plain words or leave no comment. Enums serialise as strings out (ints in). Pre-apply docs/ci-learnings.md (CA1859, CA1861, CA1869, S6964 nullable value types on [FromBody] DTOs, S107, S1192, NUnit2045, S6667, S4136). Commit: feat(refinement): a reader votes on a Work Item in refinement (story 6149).

steps.name: Only each voter's latest answer counts, and every reader sees how the votes split
steps.description: Introduce RefinementResolution, a static pure function over the log's entries: the current vote per voter key is the latest Vote (or, from slice 16, Revocation) entry by Id; voteCount counts voters with a current vote; split { yes, yesBut, no } counts current votes by answer. Changing one's mind appends and the latest wins. The split is always on the row, for every reader, voted or not.
